scope: Display active shipment drafts in Jadwal Pengiriman and print one or multiple drafts

behavior.menu: /distribution/schedules; Draf Kiriman is default, Semua Jadwal retains other schedules
behavior.print_selection: One row or multiple rows, preserved across pages and cleared on filter changes; select-all covers filtered results
behavior.document: A4 landscape, each draft starts on a new page; note/customer list, product recap, delivery metadata, quantities and signatures
behavior.reference: Derived DRF-branch-minimum_picking_id; not an issued invoice number or new database identifier
behavior.atomic_preparation: All selected draft details must load and exactly match the selected picking/order IDs before a single print window is submitted
behavior.quantity_integrity: Deduplicate ordered quantities per sales_order_detail, sum actual draft picking allocations
behavior.print_api: Existing read-only GET /api/distribusi/get-nota-draft-variant; no print-counter or status mutation
behavior.schedule_api: GET /api/distribusi/get-jadwal-armada includes branch/company/customer metadata and optional bound company filter; groups cannot merge across companies

verification.sql_smoke: PASS actual schedule query in isolated PGlite with null/explicit company filters and separate company groups
verification.browser_mock_test: PASS individual/batch print, cross-page selection, failure and stale-data cancellation, shipping disabled, filter reset and popup-blocker feedback
verification.pdf_qa: Two A4 landscape pages, separate draft on each page; rendered and visually inspected, page-specific reference/text checked
verification.production_browser_mock_test: PASS; deployed assets with intercepted business API responses and stubbed printing; no physical printer test

production.rollback: Restore the original Distribusi.py and root/dist index.html from the backup archive, then gracefully reload the verified current production uWSGI master; retain frontend assets. No database rollback is needed.

deployment_order_completed: Verify current server runtime file matches the recorded before hash and back up API/frontend entrypoints
Upload Distribusi.py and gracefully reload the verified production API; no schema migration
Verify schedule response includes id_cabang, id_perusahaan and nama_customer
Publish fresh ERP assets and replace root/dist index.html last, retaining old assets
Verify deployed UI with intercepted business API responses; do not create production transactions for testing
